skill.summary: Telnyx API integration for Clawdbot. Send SMS/email/WhatsApp messages, manage phone numbers, query call logs, debug webhooks, and access your Telnyx account....

latestVersion.changelog: Added companion skills coordination layer: pre-flight checklist (CLI installed, API key exists, key valid), auto-handoff to telnyx-bot-signup for account creation/signin/key refresh, auto-handoff to telnyx-freemium-upgrade when freemium restrictions are hit, upgrade cache awareness, and fallback messages when companion skills are not installed.
